# ubiops_pipeline_version (Resource)

Manages a UbiOps pipeline version.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "ubiops_pipeline_version" "example" {
  project_name  = "my-project"
  pipeline_name = "my-pipeline"
  version       = "v1"

  request_retention_mode = "full"

  objects = [
    {
      name           = "my-deployment"
      reference_type = "deployment"
      reference_name = "my-deployment"
      version        = "v1"
    }
  ]

  attachments = [
    {
      destination_name = "my-deployment"
      sources = [
        {
          source_name = "pipeline_start"
          mapping = [
            {
              source_field_name      = "input"
              destination_field_name = "input"
            }
          ]
        }
      ]
    },
    {
      destination_name = "pipeline_end"
      sources = [
        {
          source_name = "my-deployment"
          mapping = [
            {
              source_field_name      = "output"
              destination_field_name = "output"
            }
          ]
        }
      ]
    }
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `pipeline_name` (String) The name of the pipeline.
- `project_name` (String) The name of the project.
- `version` (String) Name of the version of the pipeline.

### Optional

- `attachments` (Attributes List) Edges in the pipeline graph — wires outputs of one step to inputs of another. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--attachments))
- `description` (String) Description of the pipeline version.
- `labels` (Map of String) Key/value labels attached to this pipeline version.
- `objects` (Attributes List) Steps (deployments, pipelines, or operators) that form the pipeline graph. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--objects))
- `request_retention_mode` (String) One of `none`, `metadata`, or `full`.
- `request_retention_time` (Number) Seconds to retain requests.

### Read-Only

- `creation_date` (String) The date when the pipeline version was created.
- `id` (String) Unique identifier for the pipeline version (UUID)
- `last_updated` (String) The date when the pipeline version was last updated.

<a id="nestedatt--attachments"></a>
### Nested Schema for `attachments`

Required:

- `destination_name` (String) Name of the destination step (or `pipeline_end`).
- `sources` (Attributes List) One or more source steps feeding this destination. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--attachments--sources))

<a id="nestedatt--attachments--sources"></a>
### Nested Schema for `attachments.sources`

Required:

- `source_name` (String) Name of the source step (or `pipeline_start`).

Optional:

- `mapping` (Attributes List) Field-level mapping from source outputs to destination inputs. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--attachments--sources--mapping))

<a id="nestedatt--attachments--sources--mapping"></a>
### Nested Schema for `attachments.sources.mapping`

Required:

- `destination_field_name` (String) Input field on the destination step.
- `source_field_name` (String) Output field on the source step.




<a id="nestedatt--objects"></a>
### Nested Schema for `objects`

Required:

- `name` (String) Unique name for this step within the pipeline version.
- `reference_name` (String) Name of the deployment, pipeline, or operator to reference.
- `reference_type` (String) Type of the referenced object: `deployment`, `pipeline`, or `operator`.

Optional:

- `configuration_json` (String) JSON-encoded configuration for this object. For operators: `expression`, `input_fields`, `output_fields`, etc. For deployments/pipelines: `on_error` policy (`stop` or `continue`). Omit if not needed.
- `version` (String) Version of the referenced deployment or pipeline. Omit to use the default version.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import ubiops_pipeline_version.example my-project/my-pipeline/v1
```
